preview.scope: Native stereo previews only. Inputs, diagnostic maps and filter workspaces consume additional memory. All frames are analyzed.

motion.scope: Screen changes include intended motion. Disparity jitter subtracts the change in intended disparity at each screen sample; this is not world-space optical flow.

colorSpread.scope: Response to a local source-color intervention with identical depth, not a perceptual ghost score.

findings.message: Strong nonharmonic matches exist outside the calibrated depth range.
